mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies at Firemans Park with a temperature of 62 degrees and a first quarter moon overhead.

Beginning September 23, the city will conduct chip seal road maintenance. Work will take place on Cross Country Road and the east end of East Verona Avenue, so expect lane closures and traffic control while crews are active between 9 AM and 3 PM.

There is plenty to do with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival happening today along with live music at Baileys Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness.
Looking at the weekly report, on September 10, officers responded to an in-progress burglary on Hunters Cove Way where a shot was fired and a 19-year-old male was taken into custody.
Culver's of Verona is closed for a remodel, but the team will be back and ready to serve you starting today at 10 AM.
